premises.text: IZkEvmVerifier.verifyBatch is an oracle: the law is parametric in it and only asks whether the router resolves an address with code

notes: Domain coherence between the commit path (accepts (version, index)) and the proof path (router must resolve the same pair). A committed batch whose pair is outside the router domain can be challenged but never defended: proveState reverts at the router, the timeout branch slashes the submitter (:613-616).
witness_or_proof: commitBatch with version v for which latestVerifier[v].verifier == address(0) (e.g. v = 0 after only v1/v2 verifiers were registered), then challengeState; proveState reverts in getVerifier / in the call to address(0); after W the challenger wins by timeout.
